verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document per-user, per-agent, or per-application memory scoping, or any tenant-isolation guarantee for retrieval. Collections group data sources behind one search endpoint, and Connect lets end users link their own apps, but neither is described as an isolation boundary that keeps one tenant's data out of another's results. That makes them adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scope memories per user, agent, or application so one tenant's memories never leak into another's retrieval
